  Scenario: AC8 The business rules BR1 to BR10 of section 8 hold at the gateway (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the business rules BR1 to BR10 of section 8
    When the gateway, its client registry, its audit stream and its opening record are checked against each rule
    Then BR1 holds: the partner gateway sits in its own DMZ zone, separate from the shared App Gateway, and partners come only through it
    Then BR2 holds: ingress is deny by default and the only allowed upstream is rwb-partner
    Then BR3 holds: the FAPI 2.0 controls of AC2 are enforced and no token or secret is carried in a URL
    Then BR4 holds: a partner user signs in with a second factor and one external identity maps to one partner user (AC3)
    Then BR5 holds: data moves only through the partner portal and the external gateway, and no mail relay path is opened for a partner
    Then BR6 holds: the edge authorises the scope and rwb-partner and rwb-debtsale authorise the object on every call (AC4)
    Then BR7 holds: every request is audited with the client, the partner and the partner user, and no token, secret, key or personal data beyond the partner user id is written (AC5)
    Then BR8 holds: a client follows the recorded lifecycle and a revoked client or an expired certificate is refused (AC6)
    Then BR9 holds: the gateway carries about 50 partner users online in the busiest hour of about 320 named users, and the partner-facing surface works on desktop browsers and tablets
    Then BR10 holds: the gateway is not opened to partner users outside the bank until the penetration test and the security review are passed and recorded (AC7)
